answer: One workable design: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because garden only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, shale is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any yarrow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
